examined_formations.title: APP_STORE_REJECTION_DIAGNOSIS_AND_REMEDIATION
examined_formations.chinese_title: App Store审核拒绝诊断与修复
examined_formations.evidence_summary: App review rejection is high-consequence and bounded by guideline/message/code/metadata state, but AcceptMyApp, AppReviewFix, AscAuto and CatDoes already provide pre-review, rejection diagnosis, fix-vs-appeal guidance, metadata/screenshot checks and submission/rejection automation.

examined_formations.title: PAYMENT_HOLD_AND_REJECTION_DECISIONING
examined_formations.chinese_title: 付款冻结与退回异常决策
examined_formations.evidence_summary: JPMorgan exposes payment-hold decisioning APIs for release/cancel integration, while SAP supports payment exception resolution and automatic resend for configured ERP errors.

examined_formations.title: IDENTITY_ACCESS_EXCEPTION_REMEDIATION
examined_formations.chinese_title: 身份权限异常自动修复
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Microsoft Entra and Google Cloud already provide policy-based automatic assignment/approval and IAM troubleshooting/remediation flows, including programmatic policy action.

examined_formations.title: PRODUCTION_INCIDENT_AUTOREMEDIATION
examined_formations.chinese_title: 生产事故自动诊断修复
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Current AI-SRE products such as Middleware OpsAI correlate telemetry, perform root-cause analysis and ship code fixes/PRs, occupying the exact detect-decide-remediate loop.

examined_formations.title: MANUFACTURING_RUSH_ORDER_AND_CAPACITY_EXCEPTION
examined_formations.chinese_title: 制造插单产能异常决策
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Modern APS systems already model orders, WIP, machine capacity and material conditions to simulate rush-order impact, bottlenecks, delivery risk and rescheduling decisions.

examined_formations.title: PROCUREMENT_ACKNOWLEDGMENT_EXCEPTION
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Microsoft's current reference architecture extracts supplier acknowledgments, matches them to SAP POs, applies business tolerances, auto-confirms matches and escalates only exceptions with evidence.

examined_formations.title: ECOMMERCE_LISTING_POLICY_EXCEPTION
examined_formations.chinese_title: 电商商品违规异常整改
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Amazon and Douyin expose explicit remediation/appeal flows; current seller tools already detect common policy violations, optimize content and guide corrective actions/appeals.
